steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Financial motivation methods: wages (hourly pay), salaries (fixed annual pay), commission (percentage of sales), profit sharing (share of profits), bonuses (one-off rewards), fringe benefits (perks like company car, healthcare, gym membership). | Key Fact: Non-financial motivation methods: job rotation (varying tasks), job enrichment (giving more responsibility and challenge), empowerment (giving authority to make decisions), teamworking (collaborative projects), and opportunities for promotion and training. | Key Fact: Maslow's hierarchy of needs: physiological → safety → social → esteem → self-actualisation.
